sources.title: GitHub - izm1chael/layerfault: Offline-first local AI model admission ...
sources.snippet: Layerfault validates model artifacts and local model runtimes before inference. It combines structural validation, package inspection, integrity checking, provenance, trust, policy, runtime advisory checks, execution binding, inventory, drift detection, quarantine, and signed evidence in one local CLI.

sources.title: Releases: izm1chael/layerfault - GitHub
sources.snippet: Layerfault is an offline-first security and admission-control CLI for local AI models. It validates model structure and package contents, establishes integrity and package identity, evaluates provenance and local trust, applies operator policy, checks relevant runtime security advisories, and can block execution when those guarantees fail.

Use it when a bucket stores dataset TARs and clients repeatedly fetch individual archived files via archpath, for example training samples in GetBatch or regular object GET requests.
